description: Ask your freight-forwarding data anything — shipments, revenue, costs, margins, P&L, and AR/AP ageing — in plain language, and turn answers into charts, dashboards, and scheduled email reports, straight from your Fr8Labs FMS. Every query is scoped to your own company's data: results are read from a tenant-isolated analytics warehouse, and reports email only to your own domain. Built for freight-forwarding operators and finance teams who want self-service analytics without writing SQL.
